title: Deleting a customer with no records removes their tier
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales, with no work orders, Part Sales, vehicles, contacts, transactions, payments or credit.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, on tier A for work orders and tier A for Part Sales, with an open work order, so it cannot be deleted.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Delete customer A from its page.
  3. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  4. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  5. Click the Customers tab.
  6. Open customer B's page from Customers.
  7. Delete customer B from its page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is deleted.

Step 3:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 4:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 5:

  • Tier A's Customers tab lists customer B.
  • Customer A is not listed.

Step 6:

  • Customer B's page opens.

Step 7:

  • Customer B is not deleted: the delete is refused as today.
  • Customer B's page still shows.
